site.name: stratabox
site.summary: stratabox-clone Fictional headless content platform "Stratabox" marketing site (Contentful / Sanity-style). Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Single-page long scroll: sticky top nav; hero with editor-vs-live-preview split panel that periodically swaps blocks; trusted-by logo strip; 4-stat row with intersection-observer count-up; 3 feature cards; **live block builder** (drag-and-drop reorder, type switcher, add/delete blocks, two-pane editor + render with debounced auto-save status); 4-language SDK code tabs (JS / Python / Ruby / curl) with copy button; 24-card searchable integrations grid; 3 customer quotes; gradient pricing teaser; dark 4-column footer | | `styles.css` | Brand color #0E7E7E warm teal + cream paper; Inter + JetBrains Mono; responsive at 3 breakpoints (>1100 / 720–1100 / <720) | | `script.js` | Stat count-up via IntersectionObserver; hero block-swap micro-animation every 3.5s; full builder logic (reorder via HTML5 drag-and-drop, type switcher, add/delete, debounced auto-save status); SDK tab switcher with syntax-highlighted snippets and copy-to-clipboard toast; integrations search filter (matches name + category) with live count |

explored_user_goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full stratabox system, prioritizing the primary pricing flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
exploration_summary: Stratabox’s UX has strengths (e.g., clear search feedback, SDK tab switching) but faces issues: drag-and-drop builder reordering failed multiple times, mobile delete buttons had timeout errors (small tap targets?), and key CTAs/links (e.g., 'See full plans', footer links) lacked interaction feedback. Coverage is substantial but 48% of features remain untested (e.g., 'Changelog', 'Customers' links).

exploration_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the Stratabox marketing site, focusing on the primary flow (pricing, product features) and adjacent interactive elements (builder, SDKs, integrations) across desktop and mobile viewports.
exploration_plan.summary: The run will proceed in phases: first, validate the top navigation and hero section interactions; then explore the builder and feature blocks; next, test SDK and integration sections; then check customer and pricing flows; and finally, verify mobile responsiveness and recovery paths. Each phase will exercise key interactables and check for layout issues.
assumptions: The site is a single-page app with all content in index.html
Interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) are functional and follow web standards
Layout warnings (small tap targets) are critical to validate for mobile usability
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (navigation links, builder buttons) for mobile usability
SDK tab switcher and copy functionality

findings.user_goal: Reorder builder blocks via drag-and-drop and update live preview
findings.problem: Drag-and-drop reordering of builder blocks failed multiple times (timeout errors, no visible reordering/preview update).
findings.evidence: Drag actions on builder blocks (e.g., 'Heading', 'Spring migration…') failed due to timeouts or no visual feedback. Session memory notes 'Drag action failed due to timeout' and 'no visible reordering/preview update'.
findings.why_it_matters: Builder reordering is core to the product’s value (drag, drop, ship). Broken feedback/functionality frustrates users relying on block-based editing.
findings.suggestion: Fix drag-and-drop logic (ensure elements are scrollable/interactable) and add clear visual feedback (e.g., block highlighting during drag, preview updates).

findings.user_goal: Delete builder blocks on mobile to test recovery
findings.problem: Mobile delete buttons (e.g., '×' for 'Spring migration…') failed with timeout errors, likely due to small tap targets or interaction timing issues.
findings.evidence: Multiple click attempts on mobile delete buttons (target_id: ux-84/85/86) timed out. Layout warnings highlight 'small_tap_target' for mobile interactables.
findings.why_it_matters: Mobile users need reliable block deletion for content editing. Small targets/timeout errors reduce usability and recovery confidence.
findings.suggestion: Increase mobile delete button size (min 44x44px), optimize interaction timing, and test mobile responsiveness of builder controls.

findings.user_goal: Navigate to detailed pricing via 'See full plans' button
findings.problem: CTAs like 'See full plans' and 'Start free' (plus footer links) lacked interaction feedback (no navigation, modal, or visual state change).
findings.evidence: Clicking 'See full plans'/'Start free'/'Assets'/'API reference' showed no URL change, navigation, or visual feedback. Session memory notes 'no visible effect' for these actions.
findings.why_it_matters: Users rely on CTAs/links for key flows (pricing, signup, docs). Missing feedback creates confusion (e.g., 'Did the button work?').
findings.suggestion: Add interaction feedback (e.g., modal, page scroll, active state) to CTAs/links. Ensure navigation/logic works (e.g., 'See full plans' links to pricing details).
findings.source_hint: index.html (CTAs like 'See full plans', footer links)

findings.user_goal: Search integrations and get results/count feedback
findings.problem: Integrations search works (valid/invalid term feedback), but this is a positive (no issue here) — included to contrast with other gaps.
findings.evidence: Typing 'xyz123' showed '0 of 24' and grayed cards; clearing showed '24 of 24' and visible cards. Session memory confirms 'clear feedback for invalid/valid terms'.
findings.why_it_matters: Positive: search feedback is clear, so users understand results. Highlight to retain good UX and contrast with broken areas.
findings.suggestion: N/A (positive finding; replicate this clarity in other features like CTAs).

findings.problem: Mobile layout warnings (small tap targets, missing labels) reduce accessibility for users with motor/vision needs.
findings.evidence: Final observation’s 'layout_warnings' list small tap targets (e.g., 'Stratabox' link: 108x26px < 44x44px) and missing input labels (e.g., select fields).
findings.why_it_matters: Accessibility issues exclude users and violate best practices. Small targets frustrate motor-impaired users; missing labels confuse screen reader users.
findings.suggestion: Increase mobile tap target sizes (min 44x44px), add labels/aria-labels to form fields, and test with accessibility tools.

findings.user_goal: Explore pricing plans via 'See full plans' button
findings.problem: 'See full plans' button failed to navigate to detailed pricing (no URL change, modal, or scroll).
findings.evidence: Multiple clicks on 'See full plans' (target_id: ux-40) had 'no visible URL change, text change, or navigation/modal feedback'.
findings.why_it_matters: Pricing exploration is critical for conversion. Broken CTAs block users from understanding plans and signing up.
findings.suggestion: Fix 'See full plans' to navigate to a pricing page/modal with detailed tiers, and add loading/active state feedback.
